title: One trajectory can obey local laws in two dimensions
kind: Exact construction and exhaustive ECA audit
summary: A lattice-quotient embedding intertwines any finite-radius 1D CA with a local 2D CA. For ECAs, 218 active lifts already have affinely two-dimensional essential stencils, and a defect-gated extension gives an affinely 2D ambient rule for all 256.
takeaway: Exact cross-dimensional evolution supplies a baseline. Redundant encoded data, the cost of physical edits, and inherited spatial programs remain separate constraints.

promotion.idea: Evolution can commute across dimensions while the local law changes

label: Dimensional intertwining
